meta.title: What does the Fast Lane cost right now?
meta.description: Get the Tel Aviv Fast Lane toll price pushed to your phone every few minutes. Free, no sign-up.

app.name: Fast Lane Now
app.tagline: The Fast Lane toll price, straight to your phone

price.heading: Price right now
price.error: Couldn't fetch the price right now

target.label: The price drops below…
target.hint: One alert, once it's actually down there and staying

drop.label: The price starts falling
drop.hint: One alert, once it's been coming down steadily

interval.label: Every few minutes
interval.hint: The price on a schedule, whatever it's doing

form.targetAlreadyMet: It's already {price} ₪ — you'll hear from us right away.

onlyOnChange.label: Only when the price changes
onlyOnChange.hint: No repeat alerts for the same price

form.summaryTarget: One notification, the moment the price has held under {target} ₪ for {window}. We'll watch for {duration}.
form.summaryDrop: One notification, once the price has been falling — and not going back up — for {window}. We'll watch for {duration}.

session.watchingTarget: We'll ping you when it drops below {target} ₪
session.watchingDrop: We'll ping you when it starts falling and stays down
session.stopped: Tracking stopped. Start again whenever you like.
session.expired: That round is over. Want another one?
session.watchFinished: The watch has ended — check your notifications. Start another whenever you like.

push.enabledToast: You're set — we sent a test notification.
push.unsupportedBody: Try Chrome, Edge, or an up-to-date Safari — or just leave this page open and watch the price here.
push.deniedBody: You blocked notifications for this site earlier. To fix: browser settings → site permissions → notifications → allow.
push.errorBody: Give it another try. If it keeps failing, check that notifications are allowed in your browser settings.

ios.title: One step first — add it to your home screen
ios.body: On iPhone, notifications only work once the site is installed as an app. Takes five seconds:
ios.step1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari
ios.step3: Open the new app from your home screen and turn on alerts

notify.title: Fast Lane — {price} ₪
notify.finalBody: Updated {time} · last update of this round
notify.watchStartTargetBody: We'll ping you once it holds under {target} ₪ for {window}. Watching until {until}.
notify.watchStartDropBody: We'll ping you once it's been falling for {window} without going back up. Watching until {until}.
notify.targetHitBody: Under your {target} ₪ and steady there for {window}
notify.dropHitBody: Down from {previous} ₪, and no rise for {window}
notify.watchEndedTargetBody: It never settled under {target} ₪. Start another watch whenever you like.
notify.watchEndedDropBody: No steady fall this round. Start another watch whenever you like.

footer.sourceNote: Prices come straight from the official Fast Lane site and are shown as-is.
footer.disclaimer: An independent free service, not affiliated with the Fast Lane operator. Only they set the final price.
footer.safety: Don't use this app while driving.
